en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town with dense, steep‑roofed houses in the foreground, a river or embankment partly visible through trees, and larger civic-looking buildings and villas on a hill behind. On the right side rises a prominent baroque or rococo church tower with an onion-shaped spire and clock, dominating the skyline. The surrounding landscape is gently hilly and partly wooded. The image has wide white margins typical of early photographic postcards. No visible printed caption or handwriting can be seen.
